lines.t: Verse 1
In the quiet of the evening,
I whisper all my prayers to You.
Of all the things I thank You for,
And of how much I love You.
I long for when You take me,
Gather me up to You.
I have been waiting,
And know Your promise is true.
(Pre-Chorus)
I’m watching at the window,
Listening for the sound of You calling me.
Chorus
Oh, my Bridegroom,
Come quickly.
I long for the day when You come and take me.
My heart yearns to be with You,
My heart yearns to be with You,
I feel a love so strong.
A love so true,
That I've had for You for so long.
My Bridegroom, come take me.
Verse 2
Through the waiting and the longing, Through the joy and tears,
You’ve been my steady promise through the passing years.
Though I cannot see You, still I know You’re nearby,
That You are gazing down on me from high.
(Pre-Chorus)
My Bridegroom, my First Love,
I can't wait until You take me,
Take me up above.
Chorus
Oh, my Bridegroom,
Come quickly.
I long for the day when You come and take me.
My heart yearns to be with You,
I feel a love so strong.
A love so true,
That I've had for You for so long.
My Bridegroom, come take me.
Bridge
You are the Holy, Promised One.
Every tear will fade away
When You call my name that day.
I will run into Your arms,
Safe within Your love.
I long for the day when You come and take me.
My heart yearns to be with You,
I feel a love so strong.
A love so true,
That I've had for You for so long.
My Bridegroom…
Come take me.
